notes.title: Updated to ver1.43(test)
notes.notes:
→ver1.43(test)

・Since there were some environments where saved data could not be loaded during the last update, we have included a stopgap measure in that case (or for the purpose of getting a casual look at various stages).
・If you press 0 on the keyboard during a stage, the stage is cleared, and if you press 9 on the keyboard, the secret goal is reached. Please use this function to restore saved data or to casually look at the next stage.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.01.
notes.notes:
→ver1.01
Stick input thresholds have been adjusted. The behavior of holding onto a ladder or entering a door with a slight up/down input has been improved.
The behavior of holding onto a ladder or entering a door with a slight up/down input has been improved.
The shallow left/right input is for walking, and the large left/right input is for running.
Basically, the game uses a dash, so the game is adjusted to run if the input is normal without worrying about it.

Changed so that when jumping from a ladder, it takes a little longer to grab it again.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Guide To Switching Languages
notes.notes:
While [i]Tobari 2: Nightmare[/i] does not have a built-in language switcher like [i]Tobari 2: Dream Ocean[/i] does, you can still access the Japanese version of the game or the English version if you are currently playing it in Japanese.

1. Go to your [b]Steam LIbrary[/b] and either right-click on [i][b]Tobari 2: Nightmare[/b][/i] or click the [b]gear button[/b] on the game page and click on [b]Properties[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40842193/ddb854c100f27c7484008e0c5296f2851c7edfe2.jpg[/img]

2. Click on [b]Language[/b] then select the language you wish to play [i][b]Tobari 2: Nightmare[/b][/i] in. After you make your selection, you will be prompted to [b]Update[/b] the game. After that, you're good to go. Good luck and have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40842193/0ee4d573800b7d32314e02af5bd5041e4d2dc70a.jpg[/img]
